claim: The venue used more electricity after its lighting upgrade.

evidence.title: Verified pre-upgrade meter summary
evidence.text: The venue's verified smart-meter records show average daily electricity consumption of 120 kWh during the four weeks before the lighting upgrade.

evidence.title: Verified post-upgrade meter summary
evidence.text: The venue's verified smart-meter records show average daily electricity consumption of 96 kWh during the four weeks after the lighting upgrade.

evidence.title: Venue operating log
evidence.text: Opening hours and recorded customer numbers were similar in the compared four-week periods.

reviews.rationale: The verified post-upgrade figure is lower, not higher.
The claim contradicts the two meter summaries.
Comparable operating conditions strengthen the contradiction.
